# Prospera Properties

> Professional property management in London, St. Thomas, and Strathroy, Ontario. Founded by Ebin Jaison — hands-on landlord services for owners with 1–5 doors.

## Services

- Full-service property management (tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance, lease management)
- Free rent analysis for Ontario landlords
- Tenant placement and screening
- Serving: London ON, St. Thomas ON, Strathroy ON
